package mini

import (
	"math"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/debug"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

func TestLeaves(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range [][2]int64{{0, 0}, {1, 2}, {-5, 1 << 40}, {math.MaxInt64, math.MinInt64}} {
		if got, want := int64(c_leaf_mix(uint64(c[0]), uint64(c[1]))), refLeafMix(c[0], c[1]); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("leaf_mix%v = %d, want %d", c, got, want)
		}
	}
	for _, d := range []float64{0, 1.25, -3e10, 7.5e-300} {
		if got, want := c_leaf_f(d, 9), refLeafF(d, 9); math.Float64bits(got) != math.Float64bits(want) {
			t.Fatalf("leaf_f(%v) = %v, want %v", d, got, want)
		}
	}
}

func TestMid(t *testing.T) {
	u, tag := c_mid(1000, 77, 5, 2.5)
	wu, wtag := refMid(1000, 77, 5, 2.5)
	if u != wu || int64(tag) != wtag {
		t.Fatalf("mid = %d,%d want %d,%d", u, tag, wu, wtag)
	}
}

func runOuter(t *testing.T, depth int64) {
	u, tag := c_outer(4096, 12345, 678, 1.75, uint64(depth))
	wu, wtag := refOuter(4096, 12345, 678, 1.75, depth)
	if u != wu || int64(tag) != wtag {
		t.Errorf("outer(depth %d) = %#x,%d want %#x,%d", depth, u, int64(tag), wu, wtag)
	}
}

// TestOuterStackMoves runs C frames with Go callbacks that grow the stack,
// shrink it with GC, and re-enter C (C -> Go -> C, two levels).
func TestOuterStackMoves(t *testing.T) {
	g0, s0, c0 := grew.Load(), shrank.Load(), cbCalls.Load()
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { // fresh goroutine: small stack
		defer close(done)
		runOuter(t, 2)
	}()
	<-done
	calls := cbCalls.Load() - c0
	t.Logf("callbacks %d, stack grew in %d, shrank in %d, traceback ok %d, fp walk ok %d",
		calls, grew.Load()-g0, shrank.Load()-s0, traceOK.Load(), fpWalkOK.Load())
	if v := traceBad.Load(); v != nil {
		t.Fatalf("bad unwind: %v", v)
	}
	if grew.Load()-g0 == 0 || shrank.Load()-s0 == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stack did not move both ways")
	}
}

// TestManyGoroutines runs outer on many goroutines with frequent GC.
func TestManyGoroutines(t *testing.T) {
	old := debug.SetGCPercent(5)
	defer debug.SetGCPercent(old)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i := 0; i < 32; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			for j := 0; j < 5; j++ {
				runOuter(t, int64((i+j)%3))
			}
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	runtime.GC()
}
